newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Old Mutual small companies fund hits 55 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Old Mutual small companies fund hits 55 mln rand.

text.p: Old Mutual Unit Trusts' new Small Companies Fund has topped the 55 million rand mark and is well ahead of projections, Old Mutual said in a statement on Monday.
It said about three million rand was flowing into the fund every day, highlighting investor interest in small stocks.
Joint portfolio managers Bryan Hopkins and Brendan Burgess said that small companies had not been affected to the same extent as large companies by the slowdown in the economy.

"We have had some excellent recent listings and we expect groups heading for their Johannesburg Stock Exchange debut over the next few weeks to show a substantial premium in their issue price," Hopkins said.
He did not want to disclose the new portfolio but, said buying had been highly focused. Sectors covered included banks, insurance, investment trusts, property, beverages, building and electronics.
Hokins said a pilot internal portfolio of small cap stocks showed growth of about 80 percent over a two year period.
